name: rondolabs-r8-F7
description: Round 9 F6. Posterior mixture: 50% frozen reference (five-match TCN + HGB4) and 50% A3 member (C3w TCN + HGB retrained with the 6 SkillCorner twin training matches at 50% weight). A multi-source correction model (HGB on the blended posteriors, ball/player geometry and past/future window means; trained on 6 twin + 5 IDSSE matches, equal total weight per source, home/away swap symmetric) is mixed in at alpha 0.7. Directed Viterbi, dead-ball prior k=4, team switch cost 6; Smart Tagging kick-off rules after decoding. Round 12 F7: a set/graph model over the ball and all players (rondo/gnn.py; 10 SkillCorner + 5 IDSSE matches) is mixed into the final posteriors at weight 0.5.
selection: Round 12: selected on N10-A, tested once on N10-B (+0.0158 spellF1 vs F6).
